pages.text: The $(l)Casting Basin$() — five bricks in an open trough. Where a Casting Table casts one part, a basin casts a whole block.

No sand, no template. A basin has one shape, so the first metal you pour decides what it is casting — nine ingots' worth for the metals, and nothing else fits.$(br2)Pour from above, the same as a table.
pages.title: One Shape Only

pages.text: Because a basin holds nine times an ingot, it takes nine times as long to cool. Right-click when it has set to take the block, or let a hopper pull it out.$(br2)Break a basin holding a finished block and the block drops with it — break one still cooling and the metal is lost.
pages.title: Pour, Cool, Collect
